title: DietarySupplement
description: A product taken by mouth that contains a dietary ingredient intended to supplement the diet. Dietary ingredients may include vitamins, minerals, herbs or other botanicals, amino acids, and substances such as enzymes, organ tissues, glandulars and metabolites.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

activeIngredient.title: Active Ingredient
activeIngredient.description: An active ingredient, typically chemical compounds and/or biologic substances.

isProprietary.title: Is Proprietary
isProprietary.description: True if this item's name is a proprietary/brand name (vs. generic name).

legalStatus.title: Legal Status
legalStatus.description: The drug or supplement's legal status, including any controlled substance schedules that apply.

legalStatus_text.title: Legal Status (text)
legalStatus_text.description: The drug or supplement's legal status, including any controlled substance schedules that apply.

maximumIntake.title: Maximum Intake
maximumIntake.description: Recommended intake of this supplement for a given population as defined by a specific recommending authority.

mechanismOfAction.title: Mechanism Of Action
mechanismOfAction.description: The specific biochemical interaction through which this drug or supplement produces its pharmacological effect.

nonProprietaryName.title: Non Proprietary Name
nonProprietaryName.description: The generic name of this drug or supplement.

proprietaryName.title: Proprietary Name
proprietaryName.description: Proprietary name given to the diet plan, typically by its originator or creator.

recommendedIntake.title: Recommended Intake
recommendedIntake.description: Recommended intake of this supplement for a given population as defined by a specific recommending authority.

safetyConsideration.title: Safety Consideration
safetyConsideration.description: Any potential safety concern associated with the supplement. May include interactions with other drugs and foods, pregnancy, breastfeeding, known adverse reactions, and documented efficacy of the supplement.

targetPopulation.title: Target Population
targetPopulation.description: Characteristics of the population for which this is intended, or which typically uses it, e.g. 'adults'.
